sources.source_name: NCS Job Postings & Employer Portal Feed
sources.publisher: Ministry of Labour & Employment (National Career Service) + Regional Portals
sources.coverage_notes: Captures formal online job postings across Indore, Bhopal, Jabalpur, Rewa, and Ujjain; requires PLFS pi_tier adjustment for unorganized/offline hiring.

sources.publisher: MoSPI (Periodic Labour Force Survey — Madhya Pradesh State & NSSO Region Anchors)
sources.coverage_notes: Anchors the online capture rate (pi_tier) between 0.28 and 0.68 across sectors, plus local alternative/gig reservation wage benchmarks.

sources.source_name: DGT NCVT MIS ITI Seat Matrix
sources.publisher: Directorate General of Training (DGT), MSDE — NCVT MIS Portal
sources.coverage_notes: Enforces institutional section-size constraints (20, 24, 40 seats per unit) and reveals ~48% ITI Phantom Capacity (sanctioned seats vs actual active enrolments).

sources.publisher: Skill India Digital Hub (SIDH) & NSDC — PMKVY 4.0 STT & Bridge Modules
sources.coverage_notes: Tracks 6-stage supply conversion funnel from enrolment -> completion -> certification -> placement -> 6-month retention, plus SkillBridge 45-90 day reskilling cohorts.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Labour & Employment — e-Shram District Occupation Aggregator
sources.coverage_notes: Provides informal worker density and unplaced/underemployed technician stock priors for Empirical Bayes cluster pooling in sparse districts like Ujjain and Rewa.
